annotations.title: Email an invoice to the client

description: OUTWARD-FACING: sends a real email with the invoice to the client's invited contacts, and marks the invoice sent. Cannot be unsent — confirm with the user first. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/invoices/bulk with action=email.

email_type.description: Which email template to send (default: the invoice template).
